errors.text_span: The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of Math, Coding, and Information Seeking, while the remaining categories collectively constitute about one-third of the dataset.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains two forms of interpretation forbidden by the prompt. First, it uses subjective language ('visually emphasizes the dominance'). Second, it performs a calculation not present in the chart ('collectively constitute about one-third of the dataset'). This calculation is also factually incorrect, as the sum of the remaining categories is 24.2%, which is closer to one-quarter.

errors.text_span: The segments are arranged clockwise in descending order of proportion
errors.evidence: The segments are not arranged in strictly descending order. The clockwise order of percentages is: 29.3%, 24.3%, 22.2%, 10.4%, 2.3%, 2.2%, and finally 9.3%. The 'Others' category (9.3%) breaks the descending sequence.
